title: The Real Test for Healthcare AI Happens Six Months After Go-Live
ai_summary: Innovaccer and Mastek are partnering to ensure healthcare AI systems remain operational six months after go-live, addressing the second test that most AI fails. The partnership aims to keep AI running in EHRs and workflows, with Innovaccer's platform cutting prior authorization prep time from 45 minutes to 3 minutes.

title: Value-based care technology ambitions outpace confidence in funding
ai_summary: A NAACOS-Innovaccer survey finds accountable care leaders are adjusting IT investment plans under the CMS ACCESS Model. They are seeking stronger evidence on outcomes, more sustainable funding, and better data integration.

title: Former Allscripts CEO Paul M. Black Joins Innovaccer Board of Directors
ai_summary: Paul M. Black, former Allscripts CEO, joined Innovaccer's Board of Directors. He brings over 40 years of healthcare technology leadership, including roles at Cerner and IBM. The appointment aims to help build the industry chassis for Autonomous Healthcare Operations.

title: Innovaccer's Flow Earns 96.2 KLAS Score, Nearly 14 Points Above the Market Average in Ambulatory RCM Services
ai_summary: Innovaccer's Flow platform earned a 96.2 KLAS score in ambulatory RCM services, 14 points above the market average. Customers reported a 93% reduction in prior authorization prep time, 21% increase in collections, and 47-point rise in revenue realization. Innovaccer will showcase expanded capabilities at MGMA.

title: Innovaccer Brings Xccelerate to Washington D.C., Expanding Its Annual Healthcare Leadership Forum Ahead of the NAACOS Annual Conference
ai_summary: Innovaccer announced its Xccelerate healthcare leadership conference will expand to Washington, D.C. on Oct 13-14, ahead of NAACOS. The event convenes health system leaders, payers, and policy officials to discuss healthcare AI adoption and value-based care, with a focus on H.R.1 and the ACCESS Model.

title: Delays, tech failures abound in CMS' WISeR AI prior auth pilot, documents show
ai_summary: FOIA documents released by the EFF show CMS' WISeR AI prior authorization pilot has faced delays, miscommunication, and provider frustration. Records include hundreds of unanswered requests, with one 83 days old, and technical issues from vendors like Innovaccer. The program, active in six states, plans to end in 2031.

title: Innovaccer And Documo Bring HIPAA-Compliant Digital Fax to the Innovaccer Health Cloud
ai_summary: Innovaccer and Documo added HIPAA-compliant digital fax capabilities to the Innovaccer Health Cloud. The advancement helps healthcare organizations eliminate paper, streamline workflows, and enhance patient-centric care.

title: How a Rural North Carolina Network Uses AI to Coordinate Care
ai_summary: Impact Primary Care Network, a North Carolina population health organization, has used Innovaccer's care management platform and dashboards for two years. The system prioritizes patients, identifies care gaps, and tracks payor contracts, supporting its rural care programs. IPCN plans to continue integrating clinical and social support through the NC ROOTS Hub.

title: Impact Primary Care Network Selects Innovaccer to Power Population Health and Care Management in Western North Carolina
ai_summary: Impact Primary Care Network deployed Innovaccer's care management platform and population health dashboards over nearly two years. The platform automates patient prioritization and care gap tracking, improving protocol adherence and penetration rates. The partnership aims to free care teams from administrative work.

title: Impact Primary Care Network Selects Innovaccer to Power Population Health and Care Management in Western North Carolina
ai_summary: Innovaccer announced a partnership with Impact Primary Care Network (IPCN) to provide its care management solution and population health dashboards for operations in Western North Carolina. This deployment serves as the operational foundation for IPCN's programs, enabling care teams to manage complex patient populations more effectively through autonomous workflows.

title: Innovaccer and Mastek partner to scale healthcare AI in the US
ai_summary: Innovaccer, an autonomous operations platform for healthcare, announced a partnership with Mastek, a global digital, cloud and AI services company, under which Mastek joins Innovaccer's Platinum GSI program. Mastek will deploy and localize Innovaccer's healthcare AI applications across new and existing markets, including agentic revenue cycle management, population health and patient access tools. The deal extends Innovaccer's presence into the UK and Europe.

title: Innovaccer, Mastek ink strategic partnership to scale agentic AI in healthcare globally
ai_summary: Innovaccer and Mastek have entered an expanded strategic partnership where Mastek will deploy and localize Innovaccer's healthcare AI applications across new and existing global markets. This collaboration, which includes Mastek joining Innovaccer’s Platinum GSI program, is intended to support Innovaccer's expansion into Europe and the U.K. by leveraging Mastek's institutional relationships and delivery capabilities.

title: Innovaccer CEO Abhinav Shashank Says Data Layer Can Cut Health Costs by 75% — BigGo Finance
ai_summary: Innovaccer CEO Abhinav Shashank says a separate data layer can cut health costs by 75%, with the platform covering 80 million American lives and removing $1.7 billion in 2025. He targets $10 billion in annual cost removal and $1 billion in recurring revenue within four to five years.
